name: Lint

on: [push, pull_request]
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  APP_ENV: testing

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint all
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Read versions
        id: versions
        run: |
          echo "php_version=$(cat ./.php-version)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "node_version=$(cat ./.node-version)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Setup node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          cache: yarn
          node-version: '${{ steps.versions.outputs.node_version }}'

      - name: Set php version
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          tools: composer:v2, cs2pr
          php-version: '${{ steps.versions.outputs.php_version }}'
          coverage: none

      - name: Get composer cache directory
        id: composercache
        run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Cache composer
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.composercache.outputs.dir }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: >-
          composer config -g github-oauth.github.com ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          && composer install --prefer-dist --no-progress

      - name: Install js dependencies
        run: yarn --frozen-lockfile

      - run: 'yarn lint --max-warnings 43 > /dev/null'

      - run: yarn pretty

      - run: ./bin/update_licence.sh -nf

      - name: Run PHPCS
        run: ./vendor/bin/phpcs --report=checkstyle --basepath="$PWD" -q | cs2pr

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
